tickets.title: Build Academic Roadmap
tickets.description:
As a Student, I want to add courses to my academic roadmap, so that I can plan my degree progression and graduate on time.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Student can search and select a course from the catalog.
- Student can add the course to an Academic roadmap.
- Added courses are displayed immediately in the roadmap.
- The roadmap is saved successfully.
- PASS: The selected course appears in the roadmap after saving.
- FAIL: The course is not displayed or cannot be saved.

tickets.title: Drag and Drop Schedule Planning
tickets.description:
As a Student, I want to drag and drop courses into a calendar, so that I can visualize my semester schedule before registration.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Student can drag a course from the course catalog.
- Student can drop the course into a calendar slot.
- The calendar updates immediately after the course is dropped.
- The schedule remains visible after saving.
- PASS: The course appears in the selected calendar slot.
- FAIL: The course is not displayed correctly.

tickets.title: Prerequisite Validation
tickets.description:
As a Student, I want the system to automatically validate course prerequisites, so that I do not accidentally select courses I am not eligible to take.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The system checks prerequisite requirements when a student adds a course.
- A warning message is displayed if prerequisites are not satisfied.
- Students can view which prerequisite is missing.
- Courses with unmet prerequisites cannot be added unless an advisor override exists.
- PASS: The system correctly identifies miss

tickets.title: Morning Class Warning
tickets.description:
As a Student, I want to receive a warning when selecting classes that start at 8:00 AM, so that I can make better scheduling decisions.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The system identifies classes that start at 8:00 AM.
- A warning message is displayed before the class is added.
- Students may continue or cancel the selection.
- The warning does not prevent enrollment if the student confirms.
- PASS: The warning appears whenever an 8:00 AM class is selected.
- FAIL: No warning is displayed.

tickets.title: Manual Prerequisite Override
tickets.description:
As an Advisor, I want to manually override prerequisite requirements, so that students with approved exceptions can enroll in courses.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Advisors can access the prerequisite override function.
- The advisor must provide a justification before confirming the override.
- The override action is recorded in the audit log.
- The affected student can subsequently add the course.
